help.title: How to read a key signature
rules: **Sharps:** last sharp + a half step = tonic.
**Flats:** the second-to-last flat is the tonic.
**Scale notes:** start from the tonic and apply every accidental in the signature.
**Relative minor:** the 6th note of the major scale, same signature.
help.example_sharps: **3♯** → F♯, C♯, G♯ → **A major** → A, B, C♯, D, E, F♯, G♯ → relative F♯ minor.
help.example_flats: **2♭** → B♭, E♭ → **B♭ major** → B♭, C, D, E♭, F, G, A → relative G minor.
help.tip: Tip: read a flat by its “belly” — count lines and spaces up from the E on the bottom line.
